biotools.summary:
URGI (Unit Resources Genomics-Info) is a service unit specializing in plant bioinformatics. It integrates genetic, phenomic, and genomic data — primarily from plants — and analyzes the dynamics of transposable elements in genomes and pangenomes.
URGI is ISO 9001:2015 certified and is part of the French Institute of Bioinformatics (IFB), the French node of ELIXIR, the European bioinformatics infrastructure for the life sciences. It is also one of the four platforms that make up BioinfOmics, INRAE’s bioinformatics research infrastructure.
